scope_description.value: A/E design services for the replacement of the chilled water system components in Building 143 (Dietetics), Tuscaloosa VAMC. Scope includes replacement of failing cooling towers, associated equipment, and R-22 chiller. Design deliverables include 35%, 65%, 95%, and 100% submissions with specifications and drawings; construction cost estimates at each submission; site investigations; and construction period services (CPS).
scope_description.quote: The A/E team, including architects, engineers, surveyors, and professional consultants shall provide design services for the development of specifications and drawings to repair or replace parts of the Chilled Water System of Building 143. Work shall include but is not limited to the replacement of the failing cooling towers, associated equipment, and R-22 chiller.
